The composition-specific material is kept separate from pure MgSiO3 bridgmanite and from the existing Mg0.88Fe0.12SiO3 perovskite. Mao et al. report an electron-microscope composition of (Mg0.9Fe0.1)SiO3 and approximately 20% of total Fe as B-site Fe3+, with the remaining approximately 80% as A-site Fe2+. They do not publish refined Fe site occupancies. The exact same-batch Pbnm lattice comes from Lin et al. (2012), whereas the fractional coordinates are an explicit MgSiO3 topology proxy from Yagi et al. (1978); no Fe distribution or Fe scattering factor is inferred. The same-batch lattice volume is 164.2517 A^3, the Table S1 measured ambient high-spin volume is 163.27(4) A^3, and the executable low-spin EOS extrapolates to V0=162.6(3) A^3. These distinct source values are preserved rather than forced to agree.

Published 300 K post-transition low-spin branch. Peritheos stores it as BM3 because the source explicitly calls the fit third-order Birch-Murnaghan; K0\_prime=4 is retained as fixed, making this parameterization algebraically reduce to the second-order special case without changing the source's family label. The article's conventional-cell wording, Pbnm structure, Z=4 topology, complete Table S1 curve, and coefficient-parity refit establish the volume basis. Do not apply this EOS to the high-spin or 18-25 GPa mixed-spin observations.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.
